issue.body:
Hi guys! I'm sorry for stupid question in advance, but it seems this place has more starlette developers then any other and i hope someone can help me. I'm just beginner with starlette/async python and trying understand how it works. I wrote this simple code:

```python
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.routing import Route
from datetime import datetime
import asyncio


async def test():
    await asyncio.sleep(2)


async def page(request):
    check = []
    check.append(str(datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')))
    await test()
    await test()
    await test()
    await test()
    check.append(str(datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')))

    return JSONResponse('---'.join(check))


app = Starlette(debug=True, routes=[
    Route('/', page),
])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, port=8000, host='0.0.0.0')

```

and how i think this will work - starlette receives request, run "page" function and inside i have 4 "test" functions with sleep(2). I thought that it will take 2 seconds to complete, but instead of 2 seconds i see 8, like it works as usual sync code.
What is my mistake? I'm really appreciate  any help)
Thanks!
issue.title: [QUESTION] Starlette async usage
